description: Empirical heating-COP map vs ground-loop source temperature and sink (supply) temperature. COP tabulated from COP = carnot_fraction * T_sink/(T_sink - T_source) at the F1a design Carnot fraction; bilinear lookup over the breakpoint grid.
source: Staffell et al. (2012). Energy Environ. Sci., 5, 9291-9306. ASHRAE (2011). Geothermal Heating and Cooling Applications. Carnot fraction and ratings reuse EC156 F1a cop-map design numbers.

carnot_fraction.note: GHP Carnot fraction reused from F1a (higher than ASHP due to stable ground source)

auxiliary_power.note: Circulation pump and auxiliary power, reused from F1a

T_source_design.note: Ground-loop fluid: mean ground 12 degC minus 3 degC loop offset (F1a)

COP_rated.note: Heating COP at T_source=9, T_sink=45 degC

map.note: Heating COP grid. COP = 0.55 * (Tsink+273.15)/((Tsink+273.15)-(Tsource+273.15)). Rows index T_source_degC, cols index T_sink_degC.
